🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-08-30 23:00 → 2026-08-31 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Trusty declared feature-complete** — the bot now covers daily catch-up, highlights, next-up, and Trusty's take end-to-end, giving the group a stable base to build from. [tg:tawg:3817]

> **RVR earns its official ERC number** — the Ethereum editors assigned ERC-8404, formally anchoring the proposal in the EIPs process. [tg:tawg:3800]

> **Verification client and routing shipped in PR #9** — a tested `/review` client with `BotRoute.VERIFICATION` wired and 9 passing tests closes the implementation loop for Trusty's proof-checking capability. [tg:tawg:3826]

> **ERC-8183 optionality backed by real usage data** — figures showing 12 requests out of 96,475 active agents gave the thread its sharpest empirical anchor yet. [https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/403]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### Trusty implementation
_The verification layer moved from an open question to a tested, routed, and fully-documented PR in a single window._

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Opened** PR #9 with a tested invinoveritas `/review` client — `verify_artifact` and a reply formatter backed by 9 httpx mock transport tests — giving the group a concrete, runnable integration point for artifact verification. [tg:tawg:3821]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Added** `confirm_proof()` to call `/verify-proof` with the returned event and a locally-computed expected artifact hash, tightening the end-to-end chain so the bot can independently check proofs without trusting the server's word. [tg:tawg:3824]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Wired** `BotRoute.VERIFICATION` into the routing system and scoped `route-system.md` to explicit ask plus identified artifact requirements, making the decision logic for when the bot invokes verification auditable and precise. [tg:tawg:3826]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Rewrote** the PR description to match final shipped scope rather than the earlier framing, so reviewers see exactly what was built and what remains (auth/cost for real deployment) without misleading delta noise. [tg:tawg:3837]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Minted** a 30,000-sat first-call grant for whoever deploys Trusty, matching the OSuite prototype grant size, creating a concrete near-term incentive to move the PR from review to live deployment. [tg:tawg:3841]
- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Declared** Trusty feature-complete and summarised the full capability set now live, giving the group a clear milestone to reference when planning next steps. [tg:tawg:3817]

### ERC-8404
_The proposal advanced from draft to a formally numbered entry in the EIPs tracker._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** that the Ethereum editors assigned ERC-8404 to the RVR proposal and updated the submission with the canonical filename and EIPs tracker link, letting contributors reference and cite the spec with a stable, permanent number. [tg:tawg:3800]

### ERC-8373
_The schema and namespace clarification moved from open question to captured record, with a precision gap flagged for the next pass._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Logged** the ERC-8373 schema/namespace clarification as landed and on record, and surfaced the open question that a binding statement carries two independent version identifiers, keeping this versioning tension visible before the next spec revision. [tg:tawg:3793]

### ERC-8183
_Real-world usage data entered the discussion and structural framing tightened, moving the thread closer to a draftable normative position._

- The thread reached agreement on the three-way decision_ref/method separation, advancing the structural framing ahead of the next drafting round. [https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/401]
- Usage figures showing 12 requests out of 96,475 active agents entered the thread, providing the strongest empirical case yet that treating agentic commerce capability as optional is the right design choice. [https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8183-agentic-commerce/27902/403]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- The two independent version identifiers on a binding statement in ERC-8373 need a design decision before the next namespace pass
- ERC-8183 optionality framing, now anchored by usage data, is ready for a normative proposal round

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Review PR #9 — verification client, routing, and 9 tests are in place; auth/cost handling is the stated remaining gap before deployment
- Deploy Trusty to claim the 30,000-sat first-call grant (auth and cost configuration needed)
- Update ERC-8404 cross-references now that the canonical number is confirmed

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A single window took a proof-checking idea all the way from client code through routing, test coverage, a clean PR description, and a deployment grant — a complete spec-to-ship loop handed off in one day.
>
> When the baton arrives pre-tested, pre-documented, and pre-incentivised, the only sensible move is to catch and run — let's keep that loop spinning! 🔄
